The '''Troukree knife''' was a knife that was made by the reptilian species of the [[Troukree]]. They had hook tips capable of easily slitting a throat. They were, according to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], made with excellent craftsmanship.<ref name="choices" />

Around 1 ABY, the [[Hand of Judgment]] helped some Troukree knife [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] led by [[Vaantaar]] settle a dispute with some [[Pineath]] over a knife that the merchants sold. The Pineath attempted to cheat the traders by getting double the money back for a supposedly "faulty" knife. The Hand of Judgment saw to it that the intact knife was exchanged for the proper cost without further arguments.<ref name="choices" />
